1.english_reference: Now [ these are ] the divisions of the sons of Aaron .

traditions.WLC: וְ לִ בְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן מַחְלְקוֹתָ֑ ם
traditions.VUL: Porro fíliis Aaron hæ partitiónes erant :
traditions.KJV: Now [ these are ] the divisions of the sons of Aaron .

1.english_reference: The sons of Aaron ; Nadab , and Abihu , Eleazar , and Ithamar .

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן נָדָב֙ וַ אֲבִיה֔וּא אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְ אִיתָמָֽר
traditions.LXX: Ναδὰβ καὶ Ἀβιούδ , Ἐλεαζὰρ καὶ Ἰθαμάρ ·
traditions.VUL: Fílii Aaron : Nadab , et Abiu , et Eleázar , et Ithamar .
traditions.KJV: The sons of Aaron ; Nadab , and Abihu , Eleazar , and Ithamar .

2.english_reference: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֨מָת נָדָ֤ב וַ אֲבִיהוּא֙ לִ פְנֵ֣י אֲבִי הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ναδὰβ καὶ Ἀβιοὺδ ἐναντίον τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Mórtui sunt autem Nadab , et Abiu ante patrem suum
traditions.KJV: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father ,

traditions.WLC: וּ בָנִ֖ים לֹא הָי֣וּ לָ הֶ֑ם
traditions.KJV: and had no children :

2.english_reference: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest ’s office .

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἱεράτευσεν Ἐλεαζὰρ καὶ Ἰθαμὰρ υἱοὶ Ἀαρών ·
traditions.VUL: sacerdotióque functus est Eleázar , et Ithamar .
traditions.KJV: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest ’s office .
And David distributed them ,

3.english_reference: both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar , and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar ,

traditions.WLC: וְ צָדוֹק֙ מִן בְּנֵ֣י אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וַ אֲחִימֶ֖לֶךְ מִן בְּנֵ֣י אִיתָמָ֑ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ Σαδὼκ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Ἐλεαζάρ , καὶ Ἀχειμέλεχ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Ἰθαμάρ ,
traditions.VUL: id est , Sadoc de fíliis Eleázari , et Ahímelech de fíliis Ithamar ,
traditions.KJV: both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar , and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar ,

3.english_reference: according to their offices in their service .

traditions.WLC: לִ פְקֻדָּתָ֖ ם בַּ עֲבֹדָתָֽ ם
traditions.LXX: κατὰ τὴν ἐπίσκεψιν αὐτῶν , κατὰ τὴν λειτουργίαν αὐτῶν , κατ᾽ οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν .
traditions.KJV: according to their offices in their service .

4.english_reference: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמָּצְא֣וּ בְֽנֵי אֶלְעָזָ֡ר רַבִּ֞ים לְ רָאשֵׁ֧י הַ גְּבָרִ֛ים מִן בְּנֵ֥י אִיתָמָ֖ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ εὑρέθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἐλεαζὰρ πλείους εἰς ἄρχοντας τῶν δυνατῶν παρὰ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰθαμάρ ·
traditions.VUL: Inventíque sunt multo plures fílii Eleázar in princípibus viris , quam fílii Ithamar .
traditions.KJV: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar ;
and [ thus ] were they divided .

4.english_reference: Among the sons of Eleazar [ there were ] sixteen chief men of the house of [ their ] fathers ,

traditions.WLC: לִ בְנֵ֨י אֶלְעָזָ֜ר רָאשִׁ֤ים לְ בֵית אָבוֹת֙ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר
traditions.LXX: τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἐλεαζὰρ ἄρχοντας εἰς οἴκους πατριῶν ἓξ καὶ δέκα ,
traditions.VUL: hoc est , fíliis Eleázar , príncipes per famílias sédecim :
traditions.KJV: Among the sons of Eleazar [ there were ] sixteen chief men of the house of [ their ] fathers ,

4.english_reference: and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers .

traditions.WLC: וְ לִ בְנֵ֧י אִיתָמָ֛ר לְ בֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָ֖ ם שְׁמוֹנָֽה
traditions.LXX: τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἀαρὼν Ἰθαμάρ κατ᾽ οἴκους πατριῶν .
traditions.VUL: et fíliis Ithamar per famílias et domos suas octo .
traditions.KJV: and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers .

5.english_reference: Thus were they divided by lot , one sort with another ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּחְלְק֥וּ ם בְּ גוֹרָל֖וֹת אֵ֣לֶּה עִם אֵ֑לֶּה
traditions.LXX: καὶ διεῖλεν αὐτοὺς κατὰ κλήρους τούτους πρὸς τούτους ,
traditions.VUL: Porro divísit utrásque inter se famílias sórtibus :
traditions.KJV: Thus were they divided by lot , one sort with another ;

5.english_reference: for the governors of the sanctuary , and governors [ of the house ] of God ,

traditions.WLC: כִּי הָי֤וּ שָֽׂרֵי קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ וְ שָׂרֵ֣י הָ אֱלֹהִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἦσαν ἄρχοντες τῶν ἁγίων καὶ ἄρχοντες Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: erant enim príncipes sanctuárii , et príncipes Dei ,
traditions.KJV: for the governors of the sanctuary , and governors [ of the house ] of God ,

5.english_reference: were of the sons of Eleazar , and of the sons of Ithamar .

traditions.WLC: מִ בְּנֵ֥י אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וּ בִ בְנֵ֥י אִיתָמָֽר
traditions.LXX: ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἐλεαζὰρ καὶ ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰθαμάρ .
traditions.VUL: tam de fíliis Eleázar , quam de fíliis Ithamar .
traditions.KJV: were of the sons of Eleazar , and of the sons of Ithamar .

6.english_reference: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe , [ one ] of the Levites , wrote them

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּכְתְּבֵ֡ ם שְֽׁמַֽעְיָה֩ בֶן נְתַנְאֵ֨ל הַ סּוֹפֵ֜ר מִן הַ לֵּוִ֗י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔγραψεν αὐτοὺς Σαμαίας υἱὸς Ναθαναὴλ ὁ γραμματεὺς ἐκ τοῦ Λευεὶ
traditions.VUL: Descripsítque eos Semeías fílius Nathánael scriba Levítes ,
traditions.KJV: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe , [ one ] of the Levites , wrote them

6.english_reference: before the king , and the princes , and Zadok the priest , and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar , and [ before ] the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites :

traditions.WLC: לִ פְנֵ֨י הַ מֶּ֤לֶךְ וְ הַ שָּׂרִים֙ וְ צָד֣וֹק הַ כֹּהֵ֗ן וַ אֲחִימֶ֨לֶךְ֙ בֶּן אֶבְיָתָ֔ר וְ רָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽ אָב֔וֹת לַ כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ לַ לְוִיִּ֑ם
traditions.LXX: κατέναντι τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τῶν ἀρχόντων , καὶ Σαδὼκ ὁ ἱερεύς , καὶ Ἀχειμέλεχ υἱὸς Ἀβιαθάρ , καὶ ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν τῶν ἱερέων καὶ τῶν Λευειτῶν ·
traditions.VUL: coram rege et princípibus , et Sadoc sacerdóte , et Ahímelech fílio Abíathar , princípibus quoque familiárum sacerdotálium , et Leviticárum :
traditions.KJV: before the king , and the princes , and Zadok the priest , and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar , and [ before ] the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites :

traditions.LXX: οἴκου πατριᾶς εἷς εἷς τῷ Ἐλεαζὰρ
traditions.VUL: unam domum , quæ céteris prǽerat , Eleázar :

traditions.VUL: et álteram domum , quæ sub se habébat céteros , Ithamar .
traditions.KJV: and [ one ] taken for Ithamar .
